product.title: Cabo San Lucas and Santa Maria Bay Snorkeling Sightseeing Cruise

description.text: In Cabo San Lucas, this sightseeing cruise heads to Santa Maria Bay for a guided snorkel with gear on the boat. The published route keeps the group on marina departure and corridor reef time rather than a multi-bay add-on. A small port tax may be collected in destination. The format suits visitors who want a compact guided swim without booking a private skiff. Commentary covers the bay and fish typical of the corridor reefs. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Cabo San Lucas, and the itinerary stays on the marina and Santa Maria Bay that define this snorkel cruise rather than adding Chileno Bay, a kayak crossing, or a downtown shopping loop.
